name: TOMATO_benchmark_videos
description: A video dataset hosted on Hugging Face intended for benchmarking video understanding tasks (e.g., action recognition, temporal event detection) across varied scenarios. It provides annotated video samples to evaluate model performance on temporal dynamics and motion-related understanding.
evaluation_method: mAP / accuracy (depending on task; detection tasks use mAP, classification uses accuracy)
reputation: A community-contributed dataset on Hugging Face with modest usage; useful for experimental comparisons but not a widely standardized benchmark.
